mapper.select: SELECT generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status FROM takes WHERE shot_id = #{shotId} ORDER BY attempt_number ASC, id ASC

SELECT generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status FROM takes WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status FROM takes WHERE shot_id = #{shotId} AND attempt_number = #{attemptNumber}

INSERT INTO takes (generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status) VALUES (#{generationJobId}, #{computeTaskId}, #{computeAttemptId}, #{operationPlanId}, #{inputSnapshotJson}::jsonb, #{inputFingerprint}, #{rowVersion}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{shotId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{provider}, #{model}, #{generationMode}, #{outputAssetId}, #{sourceDurationMs}, COALESCE(#{metricsJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{validationStatus}, 'PENDING'), #{validationFailureCategory}, #{validationFailureReason}, #{validationRetryRecommendation}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'PENDING')) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE takes SET output_asset_id = #{outputAssetId}, source_duration_ms = #{sourceDurationMs}, metrics_json = COALESCE(#{metricsJson}::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), validation_status = #{validationStatus}, validation_failure_category = #{validationFailureCategory}, validation_failure_reason = #{validationFailureReason}, validation_retry_recommendation = #{validationRetryRecommendation}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
UPDATE takes SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (#{status} != 'RUNNING' OR status = 'PENDING')

UPDATE takes SET validation_status = #{validationStatus}, validation_failure_category = #{validationFailureCategory}, validation_failure_reason = #{validationFailureReason}, validation_retry_recommendation = #{validationRetryRecommendation}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status FROM takes WHERE generation_job_id = (SELECT id FROM generation_jobs WHERE job_id = #{generationJobId}::uuid) OR (generation_job_id IS NULL AND metrics_json->>'generationJobId' = #{generationJobId}) ORDER BY attempt_number ASC, id ASC

SELECT generation_job_id, compute_task_id, compute_attempt_id, operation_plan_id, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, input_fingerprint, id, row_version, created_at, updated_at, shot_id, attempt_number, provider, model, generation_mode, output_asset_id, source_duration_ms, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json, validation_status, validation_failure_category, validation_failure_reason, validation_retry_recommendation, status FROM takes WHERE compute_task_id = #{computeTaskId}::uuid OR (compute_task_id IS NULL AND metrics_json->>'computeTaskId' = #{computeTaskId}::text) LIMIT 1
SELECT *, input_snapshot_json::text AS input_snapshot_json, metrics_json::text AS metrics_json FROM takes WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId}

SELECT ma.id AS asset_id, CASE WHEN ma.project_id = #{projectId} AND ma.status = 'READY' THEN lower(replace(gr.reference_type, '_', '-')) ELSE 'INVALID' END AS role, ma.sha256, ma.size_bytes, ma.content_type AS media_type, gr.weight::double precision AS weight FROM generation_references gr JOIN media_assets ma ON ma.id = gr.media_asset_id WHERE gr.shot_id = #{shotId} ORDER BY gr.reference_type, ma.id
